message.content: {"note_claim": "Uber announced a cut of about 3,300 corporate jobs globally (not drivers) as a restructuring to reduce management layers, not specific to Brazil or due to local economic crisis.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "A Uber Technologies vai demitir cerca de 3.300 funcionários, ou 10% do seu quadro de pessoal, no maior corte desde o início da pandemia", "reason": "The page confirms the ~3,300 layoffs are of employees in a global restructuring to flatten management layers, with no mention of drivers, Brazil, or a local economic crisis."}
